name: Yangle Ma
tagline: AI engineer · Multimodal learning & reproducible experiments
bio: I build and evaluate multimodal learning systems, from text/audio/vision pipelines to controlled fusion experiments. I care about reproducible runs, clear evaluation boundaries and useful upstream fixes.

projects.description: A Python/PyTorch research codebase for native continuous sentiment prediction on CH-SIMS v2.0 and CMU-MOSEI, with sequence fusion, matched controls, resumable training and independent evaluation.
projects.name: Multimodal Sentiment Fusion

contributions.summary: Fixed missing-face features, single-sample output handling and non-finite predictions; added English and Chinese README documentation.

directions.name: Multimodal fusion
directions.summary: Frozen text, audio and vision features; masked sequence fusion and modality routing.

directions.name: Evaluation & ablations
directions.summary: Matched controls, native dataset protocols and three-seed comparisons; negative results retained.

directions.name: Training systems
directions.summary: Source-isolated selection, checkpoint resume, seeded runs and independent replay.

snapshot.conclusion: The candidate did not pass the preregistered promotion gate; a consistent routing gain has not been established.
snapshot.summary: CH-SIMS v2.0 sequence-routing study: 27/27 fits completed, including 21 fusion fits across 7 arms and 3 seeds.
snapshot.protocol: Development VALID only; native clipped MAE, lower is better. Mean ± sample SD over seeds 13 / 42 / 2026. Final TEST remains independent.
snapshot.pending: Open research gates: fresh full repetition, author-media verification, native MOSEI method replication and final TEST evaluation.
